# Without the @sngl-pure tag a js: function is not evaluated at build time.
# The compiler has no way to know a foreign function is safe to run during a
# build, so silence means no: the call survives into the page and runs in the
# browser.
[!node] skip
env SNGL_CONSTEVAL_CACHE=$WORK/evalcache

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

grep 'toUpperCase' out/index.html
! grep 'HELLO WORLD' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import lib "js:./lib"

component main node {
    var greeting = lib.shout("hello world")
    text(value=greeting)
}

window {
    main
}
-- lib/index.ts --
export function shout(s: string): string {
    return s.toUpperCase();
}
